limitations.closure_criteria: A separately versioned public-key proof profile, key lifecycle, revocation model, and interoperable vectors are frozen and externally audited.
limitations.description: The bundled production proof profile is HMAC_SHA256_V1 and binds the exact canonical transition content; federation-wide public-key identity and key lifecycle remain deployment-specific.

limitations.closure_criteria: Closed for ASET-SEED-RUNTIME-SQLITE-SINGLE-NODE-V1; other stores require independent conformance.
limitations.description: The SQLite profile implements serialized writers, WAL, synchronous FULL, atomic state-and-audit commits, integrity checking, reopen regression, and consistent backup.

limitations.closure_criteria: Specify, implement, and audit a separate coordination profile when consensus is required.
limitations.description: Distributed consensus is not part of the minimal Seed or the bounded runtime profile.

limitations.closure_criteria: Complete unbounded formal refinement and breach-propagation proofs for a separately scoped assurance level.
limitations.description: Critical lifecycle properties are bounded-model checked, but universal breach propagation and unbounded refinement proofs are not claimed.

limitations.closure_criteria: Publish an external audit report bound to the exact release archive, source commit, and test-suite digest.
limitations.description: Independent external third-party audit of exact rc12 release bytes has not been completed.

limitations.closure_criteria: Closed by 83/83 migration coverage, 55/55 semantic regression, generated-view parity, hostile-boundary regression, and independent snapshot black-box audits.
limitations.description: All 26 rc11 requirements, 18 transition kinds, and 39 schemas are represented in the rc12 machine canon with no deferred or unclassified entry.

limitations.closure_criteria: Each deployment must complete and retain the operational acceptance checklist in docs/runtime/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md.
limitations.description: Host hardening, secret provisioning, backup retention, access control, monitoring integration, and incident response depend on the deployment environment.
